name: An Acquaintance in Southshore
summary: Brother Nimetz sends you to Southshore with a report for Loremaster Dibbs. Agitated trolls and the word “I'lalai” may be tied to Colonel Kurzen's corruption.

sections.title: A Word in the Report
sections.body: Brother Nimetz sends you from Stranglethorn to Southshore with a bundle of troll legends, fetishes, and a scout's report. The local trolls are agitated and speak of “I'lalai.” Nimetz hopes Loremaster Dibbs can tell whether this has a bearing on Colonel Kurzen's corrupted mind.

sections.title: At Southshore
sections.body: Loremaster Dibbs receives you in Southshore and remarks on the long journey from Stranglethorn. He asks what brought you there, with Nimetz's report and materials in hand.

faq.answer: Brother Nimetz sent you from Stranglethorn to speak with Loremaster Dibbs.

faq.q: Why am I going to Southshore?
faq.answer: Nimetz wants Loremaster Dibbs to examine troll legends, fetishes, and a scout's report for a possible connection to Colonel Kurzen's corruption.
Loremaster Dibbs is Nimetz's friend in the Hillsbrad Foothills, where he studies troll legends and evil magic.

faq.q: What does the scout's report say?
faq.answer: The report says the local trolls are agitated and have mentioned “I'lalai.”

faq.q: Where do I find Loremaster Dibbs?
